notes.title: A Small Update for Travelers 🌎
notes.content:
Dear players!
[p align="start"]Our team is continuing the cycle of updates for our games, and the next one in line is the Trip To Europe series! We've put our hearts into every detail to make your virtual journey across Europe even more exciting and comfortable.
[p align="start"]Here's what's new in the game:

A Sea of New Words – The game now speaks new languages, allowing even more players to enjoy the atmosphere.

New Destinations – Explore 4 brand-new, vibrant corners of Europe, where every step is a new discovery!

Fresh Achievements – Specially for the most attentive travelers, we've prepared a set of new achievements.

Smooth as Silk Gameplay – We've done a major bug sweep and improved the game's performance across all locations.

Secret Finds – Something else you're sure to notice during your strolls through European streets!
[p align="start"]🔍 Dive headfirst into the atmosphere of ancient cities! Take a leisurely walk along the cobblestones of Bruges, admire the grandeur of the Pena Palace in Portugal, and find all the hidden secrets. This is your personal virtual vacation—no packing required!
[p align="start"]Already available for download – update now and enjoy the new discoveries!
